title: Active document diverges from a declared canonical term
description: docs/journey.md uses User where glossary.md declares Professional as the canonical term for the same role.

analysis.observation: The canonical source declares Professional while the active journey document uses User for the described plan owner.

inference.statement: The two resources likely refer to the same domain role using inconsistent terminology.
inference.rationale: Both passages describe the person who creates and reviews a development plan, but semantic equivalence still requires human confirmation.

impact.statement: Readers and agents may interpret User and Professional as distinct concepts.

confidence.rationale: The textual roles appear equivalent, but the fixture contains no formal ontology relationship proving identity.

treatment.rationale: The divergence is plausible but requires human confirmation before remediation.

recommendation.summary: Confirm whether both terms represent the same role and, if so, align the active document with the approved canonical term.

review.notes: Accepted by the human Tech Lead during Batch 02 review.
